{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA test orders (revenue = '999999.99')
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'
qa_orders = sales[qa_mask]
print(f"Number of QA test orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded_orders = sales[refunded_mask]
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Filter out QA test orders and refunded orders
valid_sales = sales[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask]
print(f"Number of valid orders after filtering: {len(valid_sales)}")"}
